**Developer preview. This version doesn't do anything useful yet.**

It's the first build of the Continuum Android app: it installs and opens, but it can't connect
to a computer yet. Pairing (scan a QR code on your PC) arrives in a later version, and sending
files from your phone to your PC is the first real feature after that.

Install it only if you want to follow the project from the start. Later versions will install
over this one as updates.

### Install
1. Download `Continuum-0.1.0.apk` below on your Android phone (Android 8.0 or newer).
2. Open it. If Android asks, allow your browser or file manager to "install unknown apps".

`Continuum-0.1.0.apk.sha256` lets you check that the download wasn't damaged or changed.
